name: Happy Path - Email Own Appraisal Letter for 2025
goal: User requests their own appraisal letter for 2025 and receives it via email.
constraints: User selects 2025 from quick replies. No 'Check for team' or 'Others' path. Email delivery selected. Tool returns 'email successful'.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'only years' and isManagerAllowed is 'no'.
User selects 'Get the letter via email'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot triggers workflow and returns 'We have triggered the appraisal letter to your email.'

phases.description: Bot asks if user has any other questions.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message includes 'Do you have any other questions?'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
